topSignals.title: Elcogen breaks its quiet streak: multi-year testing cooperation with Metrosert, Estonia's national applied-research institute.
topSignals.text: Announced Sept 21, the deal gives Elcogen additional test-bench capacity and expertise for solid oxide stack validation, run by Metrosert's Hydrogen Technologies Unit. No financial figures disclosed — it's a capability/validation partnership, not a commercial or capacity item, but it ends a run of quiet days for priority stack #1. Elcogen

topSignals.title: Priority-stack contrast: Elcogen active (see #1), Topsoe now on a sixth consecutive quiet day.
topSignals.text: Direct checks of topsoe.com/press-releases and topsoe.com/news show no new release since the Sept 7 Uniper e-methanol FEED contract; the half-year 2026 statement referenced on Topsoe's press page is the same one already on file (SOEC-only Herning factory, SOFC/data-center pathway still deferred under the May 2026 roadmap review). No SOFC- or data-center-specific news from Topsoe to report.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): New — Metrosert testing cooperation (see Top Signal #1). Standing status unchanged otherwise: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform, ELCO I Tallinn factory ramping toward 360 MW/yr.
Topsoe (priority): No new news — sixth consecutive quiet day (see Top Signal #2). SOEC-only Herning factory (500 MW/yr) remains the flagship asset; SOFC/data-center pathway still deferred.

No new stack/cell announcements found from Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, or Aisin in the last 24-48h. Ceres Power's H1 2026 results are due before market open tomorrow, Sept 23 (unchanged from yesterday's flag).

Bloom Energy (BE): Close $272.89 (+2.73%), after-hours $274.00 (+0.41%) — see Top Signal #3. Market cap ~$80B; analyst consensus "Buy," average price target $280.24 (2.7% upside). Securities class-action lead-plaintiff deadline still Sept 28; Q3 earnings still Oct 27.
